_schema.note: Model registry for the 2-GPU hot-swap deployment. Every key not starting with '_' is a servable model; the key is the OpenAI `model` name clients request. Read by both vllm entrypoints (model selection at boot), model-controller (swap orchestration), and model-router (routing via state.json). Per-model serving config lives HERE, not in the compose env: the entrypoint evals the selected entry and exports these into the server process.
_schema._defaults: Optional block shared by every model. Any field here can be overridden per model, and per-model `server_env` entries are merged over `_defaults.server_env` (model wins).

fields.path: model dir as seen inside the container (/models/...)
fields.drafter: drafter checkpoint for spec decode. OMIT for spec_method=mtp (mtp uses the head inside the target) and for none
fields.verify_head: 0 | 1 -- int2 verify-head GEMM (RADIANCE_VERIFY_HEAD). +2.9% decode under dflash, neutral under mtp; 1 for dflash entries, 0 for mtp. Omitted -> method default (dflash=1, mtp=0).
fields.max_model_len: --max-model-len. Per-model context length; keep in sync with kv_cache_memory (the pin key includes maxlen).
fields.server_env: object of extra env exported into the vLLM process (e.g. RADIANCE_MXFP4*, spec-draft tuning). Merged over _defaults.server_env.
fields.kv_cache_memory: calibrated KV pin in BYTES for the (seqs=8, chunk=4096, maxlen) shape. The pin key is (sig, maxseqs, chunk, maxlen, method:depth) -- the model does NOT enter the key, but method:depth DOES, so dflash:16 and mtp:8 are different keys. Calibrate with ./calibrate-kv.sh; omit to fall back to vLLM profiling.
fields.note: operator note, not read by any service

ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B-MXFP4-OCP-GPTQ.note: ThinkingCap finetune. dflash:16 pin measured 2026-09-27 on this host for seqs8/chunk4096/maxlen160000.

Qwen3.8-27B-MXFP4-mtpfp8.note: Base/standard 27B: AMD amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4, built by ./setup-mxfp4.sh (SNAP default Qwen3.8-27B-MXFP4-mtpfp8). Shares the ThinkingCap dflash drafter. NOT on disk yet -- run ./setup-mxfp4.sh before requesting it (a request before then fails the swap; the other instance keeps serving).

Qwen3.8-3.6-27B-blend-MXFP4-OCP-GPTQ.note: Blend, dflash variant (dedicated blend drafter). Same weights as the -mtp entry below; different model name, so switching between the two reloads the instance.

Qwen3.8-3.6-27B-blend-MXFP4-OCP-GPTQ-mtp.note: Blend, MTP variant: uses the MTP head inside the blend (no drafter). Spec tuning from the MTP sweep: SPEC=8; DYNAMIC_DRAFT=1, FAST_DRAFT=1, TAU=0.20, NGRAM_STRONG=8 (from _defaults + here); RERANK=32 (MTP's argmax needs only 32 -- README.md:561, MTP-DECODE-OPT-PLAN.md:214; _defaults' 80 is the dflash value); VERIFY_HEAD=0 via the field above. kv_cache_memory intentionally omitted -- no mtp:8 pin calibrated at seqs8/chunk4096/maxlen160000, so it falls back to vLLM profiling. Run ./calibrate-kv.sh SPEC_METHOD=mtp SPEC=8 before relying on MAXLEN=160000.
